name: Equifax
outlook:
What Equifax says to expect

  • Full year 2026: revenueAs a result, we are reducing our full year 2026 revenue guidance at the midpoint to $6.661 billion, reflecting this reduction in our U.S. Mortgage related revenue.
  • Full year 2026: adjusted EPSDespite the impact of the significantly weakened U.S. mortgage market on the second half of 2026 revenue, we expect to deliver 2026 Adjusted EPS Guidance of $8.50 per share, a reduction of only $0.04 per share at the midpoint and well within our previous Guidance range.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 20, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
